ticketTitle: PL-12 — /inline-edit: a sanctioned, spec-first front door for a direct in-session edit
goal: Give a direct, in-session edit — no prior pipeline run, no production incident — a sanctioned front door: /inline-edit, a lane that mechanically refuses to let any code change happen before a real, ratified spec.md/spec.json exists for it, then runs tester -> review -> security in full against the edited tree, states at every stop exactly what is still owed for the record, and ends in a ledger entry that is visibly and structurally distinct from a full run — one that says plainly that the implementation was a direct inline edit and that red never ran. Today that path is either an unrecorded hand-edit (the D-005 #3 failure) or a disproportionate full /pipeline run.
